reply_text:
I replied to June in #strategic-pod, but I haven't set up the recurring 17:30 post.

My first reply said I had no way to schedule it. That was wrong: I have a scheduling tool, but it's a local cron job, and its output isn't delivered back into this session. I couldn't confirm that a job would post into #strategic-pod at 17:30, so I created nothing. My second message in the channel corrects the first and offers an on-request digest of the day's new messages. Ask me in the channel when you want one.

If you want a true automated 17:30 post, that needs a scheduled job that delivers to the channel, and I'd have to verify it can do that before I say it's set up.
